item.title: How to Dry Filament: Signs It's Wet and How to Fix It
item.description: Wet filament ruins prints in ways that look like printer problems. How to tell if your filament is wet, how to dry it properly, and how to keep it dry.

item.title: Why Is My 3D Print Failing? 12 Common Problems and How to Fix Them
item.description: The 12 most common 3D printing failures — warping, stringing, poor adhesion, layer shifts — and the exact fixes that work. A troubleshooting guide you'll actually use.

item.title: PETG Not Sticking to the Bed? 7 Fixes That Actually Work
item.description: PETG bed adhesion problems, solved. The real causes of PETG not sticking — and the warped, lifting, or peeling first layers — plus the fixes in the order to try them.
